Symphony – Bluetooth Speaker With Wireless Charging & Digital Alarm Clock

Upgrade your desk, bedside table, or workspace with the Symphony – Bluetooth Speaker With Wireless Charging, a smart all-in-one solution designed for modern lifestyles. Combining a 15W wireless charging pad, a powerful Bluetooth 5.1 speaker, a digital alarm clock, and a convenient phone stand, this multifunctional device delivers performance, convenience, and style in one compact unit. With universal compatibility and built-in hands-free calling, Symphony is perfect for home, office, corporate gifting, and promotional use.

The Symphony is engineered to deliver rich sound clarity while keeping your smartphone powered throughout the day. Thanks to advanced Bluetooth 5.1 technology, you enjoy faster pairing, stable connectivity, and energy-efficient performance across all compatible devices. Whether you are streaming music, attending calls, or charging your phone wirelessly, this device enhances productivity without clutter.

Key Features

  • 15W Wireless Charging: Fast and efficient wireless charging for smartphones supporting Qi technology
  • Bluetooth 5.1 Speaker: Enhanced connectivity, improved range, and clear audio output
  • Digital Alarm Clock: Easy-to-read LED display ideal for bedside or office desks
  • Phone Stand Design: Allows hands-free viewing while charging or streaming content
  • Built-in Hands-Free Calling: Integrated microphone for clear voice calls
  • Universal Compatibility: Works with Android, iPhone, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices
  • Space-Saving & Stylish: Minimalist design suitable for modern interiors

The integrated Bluetooth 5.1 speaker delivers balanced sound with deep bass, making it suitable for music, podcasts, and conference calls.

Designed for efficiency, Symphony eliminates the need for multiple accessories. The combination of a helps maintain a clean and organized workspace, making it a preferred choice for professionals and businesses alike.

Ideal for Home, Office & Corporate Gifting
